controls.name: amount
controls.doc: How hard the leveler works, percent: the one knob. It reads the declared table (LEVELER_AMOUNT_POINTS and the rows beside it) for the threshold, ratio and make-up of the downward slot and the threshold, ratio and largest boost of the upward one, linear between the table's points. 0 is the input, bit for bit, the come-up value.

controls.name: direction
controls.doc: Which way the leveler works, in the order of the integer the kernel reads: down, a compressor over the loud passages; up, an upward compressor under the quiet ones (omx_dyn's UPWARD law); both, the two in series, down first. Both comes up.

controls.name: speed
controls.doc: How fast the leveler follows, in the order of the integer the kernel reads: slow, medium, fast; each an attack and a release from LEVELER_SPEED_ATTACK_MS and LEVELER_SPEED_RELEASE_MS. Medium comes up.

LEVELER_AMOUNT_POINTS.doc: The amounts the table's rows are written at, percent; between two the leveler reads the rows linearly.

LEVELER_DOWN_THRESHOLD_DB.doc: The downward slot's threshold at each point of LEVELER_AMOUNT_POINTS, dBFS of the RMS detector.

LEVELER_DOWN_RATIO.doc: The downward slot's ratio at each point; 1 is no compression.

LEVELER_DOWN_MAKEUP_DB.doc: The downward slot's make-up at each point, dB: part of the reduction a programme above its threshold takes, so the level the operator hears stays near where it was.

LEVELER_UP_THRESHOLD_DB.doc: The upward slot's threshold at each point, dBFS of the RMS detector: what lies below it is raised toward it.

LEVELER_UP_RATIO.doc: The upward slot's ratio at each point; 1 is no lift.

LEVELER_UP_RANGE_DB.doc: The upward slot's largest boost at each point, dB, so a pause is never lifted by more than this.

LEVELER_SPEED_ATTACK_MS.doc: Each speed's attack, ms: slow, medium, fast.

LEVELER_SPEED_RELEASE_MS.doc: Each speed's release, ms: slow, medium, fast.

LEVELER_KNEE_DB.doc: Both slots' knee, dB: a leveler never runs hard.
